machine.disk: File System Personality=APFS; Protocol=Apple Fabric; Solid State=Yes

selection_rule.oligodendrocyte: highest mean log1p of Mobp, Plp1, Mog, Opalin
selection_rule.astrocyte: highest mean log1p of Slc1a3, Gja1, Gpc5, Atp1a2 (other clusters)
selection_rule.neuronal: largest remaining cluster with a glial / vascular marker score at or below the median

pseudobulk_function: uchrom.browser.web.data.Dataset.contacts(key, chrom, group=...) -> Dataset._pseudobulk (per-cell pixels summed from the .scool)
ps_method: sum over chromosomes of diagonal d / pairs at d, normalised over d = 1..60 Mb; slope = least squares of log10 P vs log10 s over 2-30 Mb
